name: Jefferson County Schools
seoDescription: JEFCOED calendar dates for Jefferson County, Alabama, including school breaks, E-Learning days, staff days, weather dates, official PDFs, and ICS downloads.
districtFact: JEFCOED calendars distinguish E-Learning days for students from staff professional-development and teacher-work days. They also identify high-school Opportunity Days and dates that may be used for weather make-up, so those labels need to remain separate in a family calendar.
calendarNotes: Use the annual JEFCOED calendar for districtwide attendance dates and the official calendar page for later revisions. E-Learning dates are student learning days, not holidays. Opportunity Days apply only to high schools, and the annual calendar does not define a single attendance rule for every high-school student. Weather dates remain conditional until JEFCOED announces they are needed. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.
